goal: Prevent wallet crashes from assertion failures when loading after an unclean shutdown
Keep wallet transaction confirmation states consistent so confirmed transactions cannot be abandoned
agreement: Concept approval for closing a race condition during wallet loading (pablomartin4btc, rkrux)
Verified and tested fix against the assertion failure (shuv-amp, dergoegge)
Unaddressed objection: reverse iteration may not visit child transactions before parents (l0rinc)
Requests a unit test because the functional test passes with the fix reverted (l0rinc)

Prevents confirmed transactions from being erroneously marked as eligible for abandonment
